title: From Bias Mitigation to Bias Negotiation: Governing Identity and Sociocultural Reasoning in Generative AI
reasoning: The paper is focused on the governance of sociocultural reasoning and ethical alignment in generative AI. It evaluates how LLMs handle complex ethical tensions, moral justifications, and identity-related contexts, specifically including religion and spiritual considerations in its qualitative analysis of model responses (e.g., DeepThink-R1's handling of religious dietary restrictions and spiritual needs).
